summary: IM Cannabis Corp. furnished a Form 6-K on September 23, 2026 carrying a press release announcing it regained compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2), the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement set forth in the exchange's continued-listing standards (US equivalent: a Nasdaq deficiency cure notice). Nasdaq staff determined compliance after the closing bid price of the ordinary shares stayed at or above $1.00 for 18 consecutive business days, from August 27 through September 22, 2026; the deficiency matter is now closed. No terms, board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics are disclosed beyond a passing reference to pending August 17, 2026 transactions. Watch for the German sale and any future bid-price pressure.
